errors.text_span: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of inference time (in minutes) across several models and methods.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the figure as a single bar chart. The figure actually contains two separate horizontal bar charts, one titled 'Marco-o1-7B' and the other 'QwQ-32B-Preview'.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis, labeled “Models and Methods,” presents categories in alphabetical order: Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, and O1-Pruner. The vertical axis, titled “Inference Time (minute),” ranges from 0 to 7
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. The charts are horizontal bar charts, meaning the vertical axis displays the categories (Baseline, SFT, etc.) and the horizontal axis represents the value, which is 'Inference Time (minute)'.
The description hallucinates a label for the categorical axis. There is no axis labeled 'Models and Methods' in the figure.
The categories on the vertical axis (Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, O1-Pruner) are not in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: ranges from 0 to 7 and employs a linear scale with tick marks every 0.5 minutes
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the scales of the two different charts. The right chart ('QwQ-32B-Preview') has a range of 0 to 7 with tick marks every 1 minute, while the left chart ('Marco-o1-7B') has a range of 0 to 2.5 with tick marks every 0.5 minutes. The description mixes the range from one chart with the tick interval from the other.

errors.evidence: The value for 'Baseline' in the 'Marco-o1-7B' chart is approximately 2.1 minutes, not 2.25 minutes.

errors.text_span: The Fast-Solving Prompt bar measures approximately 3.5 minutes, the SFT bar measures around 2.75 minutes, the DPO bar measures approximately 4.25 minutes, and the O1-Pruner bar measures approximately 1.75 minutes.
errors.evidence: All of these reported values are incorrect. The description seems to be hallucinating values that do not correspond to either of the two charts. For example, in the 'Marco-o1-7B' chart, 'Fast-Solving Prompt' is ~2.1 minutes and 'O1-Pruner' is ~1.1 minutes. In the 'QwQ-32B-Preview' chart, these values are ~5.2 and ~4.0 minutes, respectively.
